title: Kimi wa "Suki" no Daimeishi
synopsis: 1. Kimi wa "Suki" no Daimeishi I didn't think you'd still remember me once you'd gained fame. When you're supposed to pick me up, you don't even think to come. That's why, when there's someone who even slightly resembles you... Ten years ago, you left me to become a kabuki actor. But I still remember the promise from that day... You have become famous and are called "the most beautiful high school student in Japan". I'm living in a different world from you. That's why you won't even think to meet me once again...? 2. Hetakuso Kata Omoi (Hopeless Unrequited Love) All Yuri wants to do is talk to her crush in her art club, Yano-kun, yet she's able to do anything but. Getting an idea, she asks Yano's best friend, Kimidzuka, for some tips on how to make her ideal for Yano. Though reluctant, Kimi-kun helps out... 3. Eien ni Nemure (Eternal Sleep) Jin's just a lowly pirate with an incredibly handsome face and loves playing with women, but this annoying female brat, who he was going to sell as a slave with the rest of them, somehow feels different from everyone else.

title: Kono Inu to Kitara Mago no Koto shika Kangaeteinai: Kensei Maou no Yarinokoshi
titleRomaji: Kono Inu to Kitara Mago no Koto shika Kangaeteinai: Kensei Maou no Yarinokoshi
titleNative: この犬ときたら孫のことしか考えていない～犬生魔王のやり遺し～
synopsis: The "Demonic Invasion" lasted for hundreds of years, and countless heroes were cut down by the Demon Lord during their reign…! Until the hero Terios, known as The Last Hope, finally defeated the Demon Lord and brought peace to the land. But the hero Terios vanished, and the Demon Lord, thought to be dead, is miraculously reborn… as a dog!? This is the story of the last Demon Lord, now all soft and fluffy, desperately trying to live a peaceful life while protecting his granddaughter, now a fugitive targeted by all of creation. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Zettai Aku no Kaibutsu
synopsis: The Kyoju Incident—a serial murder case where 23 killers fell victim to none other than active-duty police officer Kazuki Kyoju. Though Kyoju was executed for his crimes, he wakes up to find himself alive once more, only to be informed by a mysterious girl named Ressy that he’s now a participant in a battle royale of resurrected heinous murderers. Determined to stop the atrocities of these revived criminals and wipe out killers from society, Kyoju throws himself into this twisted game. An ex-police officer takes on ruthless criminals in a deadly survival game! A dark and thrilling series! (Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: The Babe at My Back Has Her Eye on Me. I'm Done For.
titleRomaji: Ushiro no Seki no Gal ni Sukarete Shimatta.: Mou Ore wa Damekamoshirenai.
titleEnglish: The Babe at My Back Has Her Eye on Me. I'm Done For.
titleNative: うしろの席のぎゃるに好かれてしまった。　もう俺はダメかもしれない。
synonyms: The Gal Sitting Behind Me Likes Me.: Maybe I'm Screwed Already.
The gal is sitting behind me, and loves me.
synopsis: A high-school boy Sandai, who liked to spend his time alone, accidentally helped the most beautiful girl in his class, Shino, when she fell into a ditch near his home. He let her use shower at his home, and lend her some clothes, although he had never talked with her before. From that day, she started to act like his friend. In fact, she seems to like him...but that can't be! She's the most popular babe in his high school! But what he didn't know was, Shino had never went out with a guy. She was not very good with guys, and Sandai was the first guy she could talk naturally with. As they spend time together, Sandai can't help himself to have special feelings for Shino. A story of a boy whose life was completely changed by a cute babe! (Source: KADOKAWA Global)
